image.shortdescription: a quadrilateral whose sides are labeled ((2/9)*k), ((2/5)*K), ((4/9)*k), and ((10/3)*K).

solution.p: The perimeter is the result from adding the four sides together: {\frac{10}{3}}K + {\frac{4}{9}}k + {\frac{2}{5}}K + {\frac{2}{9}}k\text{.} There are two k-terms and two K-terms. We combine each pair of like terms and the perimeter is {\frac{56}{15}K+\frac{2}{3}k}\text{.}
